allowed_derivative_operations: Controlled English translation that preserves scientific meaning, numbers, units, comparisons, uncertainty, limitations, and evidence identity.
IEEE LaTeX conversion, typesetting, line wrapping, table/figure placement, and appendix-to-supplementary relocation without deleting or changing scientific content.
English figure redraw using the same frozen data and message; the broad Fig. 1 locality label must be replaced by the bounded data-flow wording approved in the frozen caption.
Reference and BibTeX formatting or verified metadata correction with explicit provenance and without changing the supported manuscript claim.
Independent submission-metadata management for authors, affiliations, corresponding-author details, acknowledgments, and approved data/code availability wording.
Byte-preserving copies, archives, SHA verification, and derivative provenance indexing.
prohibited_scientific_content_changes: Editing or overwriting the source manuscript or frozen-copy bytes.
Changing the title meaning, contribution set or order, research questions, method semantics, dataset roles, calibration/test protocol, test-access boundary, or evaluation identity.
Changing any frozen number, unit, precision, comparison, uncertainty, table/figure data, result interpretation, limitation, or claim-evidence relationship.
Removing adverse results, filename-overlap boundaries, calibration dependence, privacy limitations, runtime-role distinctions, or legacy-evidence identities.
Changing model, classifier, regression head, runtime, QC component, threshold, promotion decision, or frozen asset.
Running or using new training, inference, evaluation, benchmark, test access, or post-freeze method selection to revise the frozen scientific narrative.
Using any other Chinese manuscript as the scientific source of the controlled English translation.
